title: Patch: the game log says which keyword landed a hit, a heal, a death or a return
thread:
**Issue #3700 (data, not instructions):**

````text
# #3700: Patch: the game log says which keyword landed a hit, a heal, a death or a return
Opened by @jgoetzmann-bot.

## What it actually means
When a keyword decides a fight, the game log will say so. Today, if an enemy's 1-attack Poisonous unit hits your 8/8, the log reads "Your Giant took 1 damage in combat" and then "Your Giant was destroyed", with no reason. Once the poison animation has played, nothing on screen explains why an 8/8 died to one point of damage. After this change the line reads "Your Giant was destroyed (Poisonous)", and hovering the keyword opens its rule, as it does on a card. The same goes for the extra hits Cleave lands on neighbours, a Trample excess reaching the hero, the strike First Strike lands first, damage Pierce takes past Armor, Lifesteal's heal and a unit Reborn brings back. Players read it at every table, in English and Chinese, and in replays. No rule changes.

## Why
- R2783001 (issue #2783) gave `damage`, `damageAbsorbed`, `healed`, `destroyed` and `summoned` an optional `via`, the keyword behind the event, because "the client could not tell why a hit landed or a unit died … Hearthstone shows each of these". Only the effects layer reads it (`apps/web/src/fx/motifs/beats.ts:315`, `:334`), and an animation is over in a second.
- The game log is the record a player goes back to, and it never reads `via`. In `crates/shared/src/log/lines.rs`, the arms `Summoned` (`:356`), `Damage` (`:382`), `DamageAbsorbed` (`:430`), `Healed` (`:481`) and `Destroyed` (`:491`) all drop it with `..`, and none of their lines names a keyword.
- Everything this needs already exists:
  - `keyword_span` (`lines.rs:291`) prints a keyword as the glossary's term in the reader's language, with its tooltip, as the `KeywordGranted` line already does (`:593`).
  - `crates/shared/data/glossary.json` has an entry for each of the seven keywords `via` can carry.
  - The view already removes `via` along with a hidden card (`crates/engine/src/view_for.rs:2111`, `:2136`, `:2346`; R97), so the log cannot name a keyword the viewer may not know.

## Proposal
In `crates/shared/src/log/lines.rs`, read `via` in those five arms. When it is set, end the line with the keyword as a `keyword_span`. For example:
- `damage`: "Your Giant took 3 damage in combat (Cleave)", "Your hero took 2 damage in combat (Trample)", likewise "(First Strike)" and "(Pierce)", in the "dealt" form and the Armor forms too.
- `damageAbsorbed`: the hit's keyword, as the event carries it.
- `healed`: "Your Brute healed 3 (Lifesteal)".
- `destroyed`: "Your Giant was destroyed (Poisonous)"; First Strike's death marker reads "(First Strike)".
- `summoned` with Reborn: "Your Ghoul came back (Reborn)".

A line whose event has no `via` reads exactly as it does today. Each new sentence key gets its Chinese entry in `crates/shared/data/zh-CN.json`.

This is presentation only (CLAUDE.md rule 7): no engine, wire or hash change, and no rule. If the builder judges the wording to be a decision the spec should record, it writes a ruling note in this issue's block, as R1360 did for the log's Armor part.

## Where it lands
- `crates/shared/src/log/lines.rs`: the five arms.
- `crates/shared/data/zh-CN.json`.
- `crates/shared/tests/log.rs`.
- `apps/web/src/game/Log.test.tsx`, only if a line it asserts changes.
- SPEC §10.3 (events) and §10.10 (the client's rendering); R2783001 and R97.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] For each keyword on each event it can ride, a test in `crates/shared/tests/log.rs` feeds the event with `via` set and finds a `Span::Keyword` for that keyword on the line. That is Cleave, Trample, First Strike and Pierce on `damage` and `damageAbsorbed`; Lifesteal on `healed`; Poisonous and First Strike on `destroyed`; and Reborn on `summoned`.
- [ ] A test shows that the same events without `via` give exactly today's lines.
- [ ] A test reads a line with `via` in Chinese and finds the Chinese keyword and sentence.
- [ ] A test with a hidden source or card, whose view has dropped `via`, finds no keyword named.
- [ ] `cargo test -p jackioh-shared`, `cargo clippy -p jackioh-shared --all-targets -- -D warnings`, `cargo fmt --check` and `pnpm --dir apps/web test src/game/Log.test.tsx` pass.

## Size and risks
Small to medium, in one crate: five match arms, about eight sentence keys with their translations, and six to eight tests.

Risks:
- A web test that holds one of the changed sentences word for word needs updating. The exact-text grep found `apps/web/src/game/Log.test.tsx` and `apps/web/src/stats/showcase.test.ts`.
- The Reborn and First Strike lines need careful wording, so they read as a reason and not as a second event.

_Written by `claude-6` (claude, `sonnet`, medium) ([run](https://github.com/Jlore-Studios/JackiOh/actions/runs/43052039659)) before anyone built this. The night bot's builder starts from this section: edit it here to change the plan._

## Goal

The game log names the keyword behind a hit, a heal, a death or a return. When a `damage`, `damageAbsorbed`, `healed`, `destroyed` or `summoned` event carries `via`, its line ends with the keyword as a `keyword_span`. That is the glossary term in the reader's language, with its tooltip, as the `KeywordGranted` line prints it. A line whose event has no `via` reads exactly as it does today. A reader of Chinese gets the Chinese sentence and keyword. The view already drops `via` with a hidden card (R2783001, R97), so no hidden keyword can appear. There is no engine, wire, hash or rule change, and no new ruling.

## Files to touch

| File | Change |
|---|---|
| `crates/shared/src/log/lines.rs` | `describe`: add a `by` closure and read `via` in the `Summoned`, `Damage`, `DamageAbsorbed`, `Healed` and `Destroyed` arms. |
| `crates/shared/data/zh-CN.json` | Two new entries: the suffix key and the Reborn key. |
| `crates/shared/tests/log.rs` | New tests (listed below). |
| `crates/shared/README.md` | One sentence in the "`src/log/`" section saying a line ends with its event's `via` keyword. |

Do not touch these:
- `crates/engine`, `crates/cards`, `crates/ai`, `apps/web` source and the wire files `apps/web/src/wire/**`.
- `.github/`, `.harness/`, `.squishy/`, `bot/`.
- `spec/11-rulings.md`, `spec/INDEX.md`, and any `spec/pending` or `spec/rulings` note.

Governing text: SPEC §10.3 and §10.10, R2783001 and R97 (the view drops `via` with a hidden card), R1360 and R1361 (the Armor lines). CLAUDE.md rule 7.

## Steps

1. In `lines.rs`, import `KeywordKind` from `jackioh_engine::wire`. It is `Copy` and has `as_str(self)`. Nothing else needs importing: `keyword_span`, `sentence`, `Part` and `cap` are already in scope.

2. In `describe`, right after the `let s = …` closure, add:
   ```rust
   // R2783001: the line ends with the keyword behind its event, where the event names one.
   let by = |line: Vec<Span>, via: Option<KeywordKind>| match via {
       Some(kind) => s(
           "{sentence} ({keyword})",
           vec![p("sentence", line), p("keyword", keyword_span(names, kind.as_str()))],
       ),
       None => line,
   };
   ```
   The sentence literal must be the first argument of `s(`, because `tests/log.rs::sentences()` scans for it.

3. `Summoned` arm:
   - Add `via` to the destructuring and drop the `..`. Check the field list in `crates/engine/src/wire/events.rs` (~line 380-405): the fields not already named are `source_id`, `x`, `embiggened`, `former_id`, `arrived_during`, `exits_from`, `creator`. Keep `..` for those.
   - Leave the face-down-trap early return alone. Reborn is never a trap.
   - Replace the final `cap(s("{card} entered {whose} {zone}", parts))` with:
     ```rust
     let reborn = *via == Some(KeywordKind::Reborn) && !hidden(def_id);
     let line = if reborn {
         s("{card} came back in {whose} {zone}", parts)
     } else {
         s("{card} entered {whose} {zone}", parts)
     };
     cap(by(line, via.filter(|_| !hidden(def_id)).copied()))
     ```
   - If `KeywordKind` has no `PartialEq`, use `matches!`. It derives `PartialEq` through `string_union!`, so `==` is fine. Adjust for `via` being `&Option<KeywordKind>`.
   - `cap` wraps `by` so the line still opens with a capital.

4. `Damage` arm:
   - Add `via` to the destructuring (it currently ends in `..`).
   - Bind the whole existing `if let Some(source) … else …` expression as `let line = …;`. Do not change its inner text.
   - End the arm with `by(line, *via)`. This covers the "dealt" form, the Armor forms and the combat forms.

5. `DamageAbsorbed` arm: add `via` to the destructuring. Bind the existing `match source { … }` as `let line = …;` and end with `by(line, *via)`.

6. `Healed` arm: destructure `via`. Wrap the existing `s("{target} healed {amount}", …)` in `by(…, *via)`.

7. `Destroyed` arm: destructure `via`. Change it to `cap(by(s("{card} was destroyed", …), via.filter(|_| !hidden(def_id)).copied()))`. Add `def_id` to the bindings by name; it is already bound.

8. `zh-CN.json`: add two entries, placed next to the "Lucky rolled" entry (~line 225) and the "entered" entry (~line 230) respectively:
   - `"{sentence} ({keyword})": "{sentence}（{keyword}）"`
   - `"{card} came back in {whose} {zone}": "{card}回到了{whose}{zone}"`

   `every_chinese_entry_keeps_the_tokens_of_its_english_key` needs each entry to keep its tokens, and these do.

9. `crates/shared/README.md`: add the one sentence.

## Decisions the task left open

- **One generic suffix key, not eight per-event keys.** Rejected: separate keys per line variant. The 8 or so line variants would each need a translation, and the keyword part is identical for all of them.
- **Reborn gets its own key, "came back in {whose} {zone}".** I kept the zone, so the line does not lose the lane. I rejected the issue's literal "came back" with no zone, and the bare "entered … (Reborn)" suffix, because that second event-shaped wording reads as a plain summon.
- **Defence in depth.** `Summoned` and `Destroyed` ignore `via` when `def_id` is the `HIDDEN_CARD` sentinel, even though the view already dropped it. `Damage` and `DamageAbsorbed` need nothing extra: a hidden source drops `via` in `view_for`, and a combat hit names no source.
- **No ruling note.** This is wording on top of R2783001. If the builder disagrees, the next free number is R3700000 in the block R3700000–R3700999, with its test named `r3700000_…` and its §11 paragraph in `spec/pending/3700.md`.

## Tests

All new tests are in `crates/shared/tests/log.rs`, after `a_hit_names_its_source_off_combat_only_and_only_where_the_view_names_it`. Use the existing helpers (`board`, `bare`, `hit`, `call`, `english`, `name_of`). Add one small helper to the file:

```rust
fn keywords(view: &PlayerView, locale: Locale) -> Vec<Vec<String>>
```

It returns, for each line, the ids of its `Span::Keyword` entries (`entry.id`). Cover nested spans for the "dealt" form: look in `line.text.spans` top level, which is where `keyword_span` puts it.

- `fn a_hit_names_the_keyword_behind_it`. Feed `hit` with `via` set for each of "Cleave", "Trample", "First Strike" and "Pierce". Use `combat: true` and `targetId: "u1"`. Also feed `damageAbsorbed` with each of those four.
  - Assert each line carries exactly that keyword span.
  - Assert that `full` ends with ` (Cleave)` and so on.
  - Include one "dealt" form (`combat: false`, `sourceId: "e1"`, with `absorbed: 2`), one Armor-combat form and one hero target (`targetId: "hero-p1"`).
- `fn a_heal_a_death_and_a_return_name_the_keyword_behind_them`:
  - `healed` with "Lifesteal" gives `"{panther} healed 3 (Lifesteal)"`. Here "{panther}" stands for `format!("{} …", name_of("core-032"))`.
  - `destroyed` with "Poisonous" and with "First Strike". Use `instanceId: "u1"`, `defId: "core-032"`, `owner` and `controller: "p1"`, `attack: 3`, `maxHealth: 4`, `killerId: null`. Compare against `"{panther} was destroyed (Poisonous)"` and the First Strike form.
  - `summoned` with "Reborn". Use `player: "p1"`, `instanceId: "u1"`, `defId: "core-032"`, `row: "units"`, `lane: 1`, plus whatever required fields `summoned` has. Copy the shape from an existing `summoned` event in this file (`mana_and_summons_are_in_words…`). Assert `"{panther} came back in your lane 1 (Reborn)"`.
  - Assert each carries a `Span::Keyword` for its keyword.
- `fn r2783001_events_without_via_read_as_they_did`. Feed the same events without `via`: all of the above, plus the existing ones. Assert the exact old sentences: `"{panther} took 3 damage in combat"`, `"{panther}'s Armor absorbed 3 damage"`, `"{panther} healed 3"`, `"{panther} was destroyed"` and `"{panther} entered your lane 1"`. Assert that no line has a keyword span.
- `fn a_reader_of_chinese_reads_the_keyword_and_the_sentence_in_chinese`. Use `Locale::ZhCn` with one `damage` event with "Poisonous" and `combat: true`, plus a Reborn `summoned`. Assert the line ends in `（剧毒）`, or whatever `reader_keyword` gives for Poisonous. To avoid guessing, compare with the Chinese `keyword` span text from the same line, and assert `full` contains `（` and `）` and that the Reborn line contains `回到了`.
- `fn a_hidden_card_or_source_names_no_keyword`:
  - A `destroyed` and a `summoned` whose `defId` is `"hidden"` and `instanceId` is `"hidden"`, no `via`. Check the real shape in the file's existing hidden-card tests (e.g. `a_hidden_card_that_was_buffed…`). No keyword span is expected.
  - The same two events but with `via` set. The defence in step 3 or 7 must give no keyword.
  - A `damage` with `sourceId: "hidden"` and no `via`.
- The two existing scan tests must stay green: `every_sentence_the_log_writes_has_a_chinese_entry` and `every_chinese_entry_keeps_the_tokens_of_its_english_key`. They are what checks step 8.

Commands:
```
cargo test -p jackioh-shared --test log
cargo test -p jackioh-shared
cargo clippy -p jackioh-shared --all-targets -- -D warnings
cargo fmt --check
pnpm --dir apps/web test src/game/Log.test.tsx
```

## Done when

- [ ] `damage` and `damageAbsorbed` name Cleave, Trample, First Strike and Pierce, in the "dealt", Armor, combat and hero forms.
- [ ] `healed` names Lifesteal; `destroyed` names Poisonous and First Strike; `summoned` names Reborn.
- [ ] Events without `via` give exactly the old lines.
- [ ] The Chinese keyword and sentence are tested.
- [ ] A hidden card or source names no keyword.
- [ ] The README sentence is added.
- [ ] `cargo test -p jackioh-shared`, clippy on `jackioh-shared`, `cargo fmt --check` and `Log.test.tsx` all pass.
- [ ] `cargo jackioh spec check` passes (no ruling is added or cited).
- [ ] `git status` shows no change under `apps/web/src/wire` and none outside the four listed files.

## Risks

- **Existing web assertions.** `Log.test.tsx` and `showcase.test.ts` hold lines with no `via`, so they should stay green. `showcase.test.ts`'s "healed 96" and "took N damage" strings are stats text, not log lines. If a `Log.test.tsx` expectation breaks, check that its fixture event has no stray `via` before touching the test.
- **Sentence scan.** `sentences()` finds literals by pattern: the new `s("{sentence} ({keyword})"…)` and `s("{card} came back in …")` calls each keep their literal on the call's own line, as the neighbours do. Do not build them with `format!`.
- **Capitalisation.** `cap` must wrap `by(...)` in the `Summoned` and `Destroyed` arms, or a line that opens with "your" or "a" loses its capital.
- **Hidden information.** Only the event's own `via` is read, never the view's board, so a keyword the viewer may not know is never looked up.

## Open questions

None.
````
